purpose: Anti-hallucination wiki re-verification of MELEE_ABILITIES AbilitySpec bands against individual RuneScape Wiki ability pages. Promote only wiki-sourced damage bands, hit counts, adrenaline, and cooldowns. Do not re-add CSM-removed abilities (Cleave, Sever, Smash, Destroy, Quake, Frenzy, etc.).
method: web_fetch of each mandated ability page (infobox + usage + 2026 update history). Cross-check engine src/combat/styles/melee/abilities.ts and data/combat/abilities.json melee records.
verdict: All engine AbilitySpec damage bands, hit counts, adrenaline gain/cost, and cooldowns match live wiki infoboxes as of 2026-07-26. No band number fixes required. Provenance for Attack and Berserk updated from modernisation patch notes to individual ability pages. CSM-removed abilities remain absent. Hurricane multi-band is engine-only (JSON damagePercent is a flattened schema stand-in; mechanicalImplementation points at engine).

wiki_notes.note: Infobox and CSM history use 25-35% per hit (avg 30%, total 240%). Body prose still says 25-31% from pre-CSM 4 Mar 2024 range — treat as stale. Engine keeps 25-35.
Base band 75-95 verified. Idle add-on is variable (tooltip 5-7% per 0.6s idle, cap 6s) — kept in MELEE_EFFECTS, not a fixed AbilityHit band.
Missing-LP scale up to +65% at 4 Bloodlust is target-stage; MELEE_EFFECTS only, not a fixed band.
2.5x when target LP < 50% is target-stage; base band 110-130 only in AbilitySpec.

abilities.json damagePercent [135,185] with hits:2 is a flat adapter stand-in (avg 320 correct; per-hit min/max wrong if used alone). Engine hurricane has 135-165 + 155-185 and is preferred via ENGINE_ID_BY_RECORD_ID.
